rounds.text: Hit Kit Global Solutions Ltd is fundamentally undervalued when measured against its asset backing, trading at a price-to-book ratio of 0.79x with the price at ₹ 1.89 against a book value of ₹ 2.40 [E2]. This asset discount is even more striking compared to the broader sector benchmark P/B of 7.51x [E7]. The business demonstrates accelerating top-line momentum, evidenced by a 3-year compounded sales growth of 56% [E16] and a 5-year compounded sales growth of 37% [E15], far outstripping its 10-year historical pace of 4% [E14]. Furthermore, the company achieves a positive return on assets of 0.68%, which stands in stark contrast to a dismal sector benchmark of -40.93% [E8]. Conceded: the trailing twelve months profit growth has dropped by -55% [E19] and the stock currently yields 0.00% in dividends [E4].
